scope: Diagnose which supplied analysis step explains a flawed captured mean growth, then compare captured repair results. The activity does not run a repair or infer that any selected step is correct.
prediction_prompt: Predict the mean from the supplied changes of 1, 2 and 3 cm, and name a check that could detect a wrong summary.
expected_source_inputs: A public scene objective asking the learner to diagnose an analysis
A documented sequence of analysis steps with stable identifiers
Captured flawed and repair results with units and an independently checked teaching criterion

independent_checks.description: The three supplied changes sum to 6 cm, so their mean is 6 divided by 3, or 2 cm.
Every displayed number is supplied in this fixture; the browser does not execute an analysis.
The criterion identifies the supported repair without treating the learner's selected step as an automatic grade.

source.title: Synthetic seedling-growth analysis record
source.statement: Three synthetic pots changed by 1, 2 and 3 cm, for a total of 6 cm. The captured analysis reports a mean change of 3 cm.

steps.label: Read per-pot changes
steps.description: Use the supplied changes of 1, 2 and 3 cm.

steps.label: Sum the changes
steps.description: Add the three supplied changes to obtain 6 cm.

steps.label: Divide by two
steps.description: The flawed analysis divides the 6 cm total by 2 and reports 3 cm.

repairs.label: Divide by the actual count
repairs.explanation: Divide the supplied 6 cm total by all 3 pots.

repairs.label: Drop the smallest change
repairs.explanation: Without justification, remove the 1 cm change and average the remaining 2 and 3 cm changes.
